title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Pork Chops Skewers
description: A festive Jamaican dish featuring pork chops with a mustardy and shaggy texture, made with a yuzu cure and vegetarian friendly options.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, grated ginger, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork chops to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork chops onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
